history.summary: Listed as '1BR' but at 1,237 sqft freehold this is clearly a large multi-bedroom unit mislabelled — rated as the actual large FH unit. Priced at $1,237 psf, well below the $1,554 median (~20% under), in a 2012 freehold near Balestier/Novena, with a solid 4.2%/yr resale CAGR on a thin 26-txn series.
history.rating_rationale: The headline sub-median PSF ($1,237 vs $1,554, ~20% below) and the high score_1000 (680) are eye-catching, but the bedroom label is wrong — 1,237 sqft is a large unit, so the cheap PSF partly reflects size, not a bargain. The $1.53M quantum is liquid and freehold is a plus, with a respectable 4.2%/yr CAGR, but only 26 txns make that rate semi-reliable, and the 1.12km/14-min walk to Novena MRT is poor. A fair-value large FH unit in a small development — balanced, not a standout buy.
red_flags: Bedroom count mislabelled (1,237 sqft is not a 1BR); cheap PSF partly a size artefact
1.12km/14-min walk to Novena MRT — weak connectivity
catalysts: Freehold tenure with sub-median PSF entry
Central D12 location near Novena medical hub and Balestier
